title: 외래어 표기: 간판과 메뉴의 외래어 바르게 읽기
objective: You can read loanwords on signs, menus and floor guides and choose the standard spelling using four simple rules.
summary: Learners read and check English loanwords on Korean menus and signs.
note: Real signs and menus do not always use the standard spelling. Read them aloud to guess the word.

task.title: Read and spell loanwords
task.line: Use the four rules and the word list to choose, check, find or write each loanword.

sections.heading: Four rules behind loanword spelling
paragraphs: Korean writes loanwords in Hangeul by how they sound, not by their English spelling. Four rules: (1) No tense consonants (ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ): 버스, not 뻐스. (2) English f becomes ㅍ and v becomes ㅂ: 파일, 비디오. (3) After ㅈ and ㅊ, use a plain vowel: 주, not 쥬. (4) Only seven letters can be a final consonant: ㄱ ㄴ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅅ ㅇ. A final t sound is written ㅅ (로봇), and a final k sound after a long vowel or diphthong (not a short vowel) becomes 크 (케이크).

sections.heading: Loanwords you will see on menus and signs

items.text: After ㅈ, write a plain vowel: 주, not 쥬.
It may sound like 까페, but the standard spelling has no tense consonant.
Written with ㅅ, not ㅆ; in shops it often means something extra for free.
f becomes ㅍ, so 파이팅 is standard, though 화이팅 is common in speech.
After the vowel sound in 'cake' (not a short vowel), a final k sound is not written as a final consonant; it gets its own syllable 크.
The final t sound is written with ㅅ.
Shop signs often write 악세사리, but the standard is 액세서리.
Follow the English sound, not the letters: 디지털, not 디지탈.
items.example: 요즘은 디지털 카메라보다 휴대폰으로 사진을 찍어요.

sections.heading: Reading tip: signs vs. standard spelling

points.lead: Shop names, menus and ads often use popular or stylish spellings such as 까페, 화이팅 and 악세사리

points.text: to recognize both forms when you read.

points.lead: In emails, forms and tests, use the standard spelling

exercises: Choose the standard spelling: ① (쨈 / 잼) ② (비젼 / 비전) ③ (파일 / 화일) ④ (커피숍 / 커피숖)
Read the floor guide and write the floor: [1층 화장품·액세서리 | 2층 패션·스포츠 | 3층 디지털 가전·휴대폰·노트북 | 4층 뷔페·푸드코트] ① 노트북을 사고 싶어요. ② 점심을 먹고 싶어요. ③ 귀걸이를 사고 싶어요.
These sign spellings break one of the four rules. Write the standard spelling: ① 레져 ② 뻐스 ③ 후라이팬
Is the spelling standard? Write O or X: ① 로봇 ② 텔레비젼 ③ 슈퍼마켓 ④ 쎈터
Write the loanword in standard Korean spelling: ① 어제 좋아하는 가수의 ____ 미팅에 갔어요. (fan) ② 이 식당에서는 ____와 숟가락을 같이 줘요. (fork)
answers: ① 잼 ② 비전 ③ 파일 ④ 커피숍
① 레저 ② 버스 ③ 프라이팬
① O ② X ③ O ④ X
